content: Diagnostic Event Manager (DEM) The DEM is responsible for processing and storing diagnostic events, fault memories, DTC statuses, and associated freeze frame data. function Dem_SetEventStatus [SWS_CP_DIAG_00001] Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId, Dem_EventStatusType EventStatus); Service to report the status of a diagnostic event by SW-Cs or BSW modules. Triggers internal fault debounce algorithms (counter-based or timer-based) before transitioning qualification states. function Dem_ResetEventStatus [SWS_CP_DIAG_00002] Std_ReturnType Dem_ResetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId); Resets the fault debounce counter and event qualification status for the specified diagnostic event. function Dem_GetEventStatus [SWS_CP_DIAG_00003] Std_ReturnType Dem_GetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId, Dem_UdsStatusByteType* EventStatusByte); Reads the current UDS status byte (ISO 14229-1: testFailed, testFailedThisOperationCycle, pendingDTC, confirmedDTC, testNotCompletedSinceLastClear, testFailedSinceLastClear, testNotCompletedThisOperationCycle, warningIndicatorRequested) for the event. function Dem_GetEventFailed [SWS_CP_DIAG_00004] Std_ReturnType Dem_GetEventFailed(Dem_EventIdType EventId, boolean* EventFailed); Returns TRUE if the diagnostic event is currently qualified as failed. function Dem_SetEventAvailable [SWS_CP_DIAG_00005] Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventAvailable(Dem_EventIdType EventId, boolean AvailableStatus); Enables or suppresses the availability of a diagnostic event depending on variant coding and hardware configuration. Diagnostic Communication Manager (DCM) The DCM implements unified diagnostic services according to ISO 14229-1 (UDS) and ISO 15765-4 (OBD). It manages diagnostic sessions, security levels, and service routing. function Dcm_GetActiveProtocol [SWS_CP_DIAG_00010] Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetActiveProtocol(Dcm_ProtocolType* ActiveProtocol); Returns the currently active diagnostic protocol (e.g. UDS_ON_CAN, UDS_ON_IP, OBD). function Dcm_ResetToDefaultSession [SWS_CP_DIAG_00011] Std_ReturnType Dcm_ResetToDefaultSession(void); Resets the diagnostic session to DEFAULT_SESSION (0x01) upon S3Server timer expiration or protocol termination. function Dcm_GetSesCtrlType [SWS_CP_DIAG_00012] Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetSesCtrlType(Dcm_SesCtrlType* SesCtrlType); Provides the active session type (Default, Programming, Extended Diagnostic, or Safety System Session). function Dcm_GetSecurityLevel [SWS_CP_DIAG_00013] Std_ReturnType Dcm_GetSecurityLevel(Dcm_SecLevelType* SecLevel); Provides the current security access level granted via SecurityAccess (0x27) seed & key exchange. Default Error Tracer (DET) The DET handles development errors, runtime errors, and transient faults across all BSW modules and SW-Cs. function Det_ReportError [SWS_CP_DIAG_00020] Std_ReturnType Det_ReportError(uint16 ModuleId, uint8 InstanceId, uint8 ApiId, uint8 ErrorId); Reports development errors detected during assertion checks and pre-condition validations. function Det_ReportRuntimeError [SWS_CP_DIAG_00021] Std_ReturnType Det_ReportRuntimeError(uint16 ModuleId, uint8 InstanceId, uint8 ApiId, uint8 ErrorId); Reports non-fatal production runtime errors without breaking development execution flow. function Det_ReportTransientFault [SWS_CP_DIAG_00022] Std_ReturnType Det_ReportTransientFault(uint16 ModuleId, uint8 InstanceId, uint8 ApiId, uint8 FaultId); Reports transient hardware or communication faults requiring statistical filtering. Diagnostic Log and Trace (DLT) The DLT module collects log messages and trace points and formats them into standardized DLT frames for external tooling. function Dlt_SendLogMessage [SWS_CP_DIAG_00030] Dlt_ReturnType Dlt_SendLogMessage(const Dlt_MessageHeaderType* Header, const uint8* LogData, uint16 LogDataLength); Transmits a formatted log message with log severity level (Fatal, Error, Warn, Info, Debug, Verbose) to the DLT communication buffer. function Dlt_RegisterContext [SWS_CP_DIAG_00031] Dlt_ReturnType Dlt_RegisterContext(const uint8 AppId[4], const uint8 ContextId[4], const uint8* AppDesc, const uint8* ContextDesc); Registers a logging context with human-readable descriptions for selective runtime filtering.
